question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

Our little ones needs to get the desired hours of sleep every day.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect verb form "needs" used with the plural subject "ones."
 
• The correct verb form should be "need" to agree with the plural subject "ones."
 
• The correct phrase should be "Our little ones need," ensuring subject-verb agreement.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Our little ones need to get the desired hours of sleep every day."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "No error"** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 3.
 
• **2: "to get the desired hours"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **4: "of sleep every day."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
